problems_encountered.problem: Network too slow (~100KB/s) to pip install torch 2.9.0 (~900MB) in plain openEuler CANN image
problems_encountered.solution: Switched to MindIE image (swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/inference/ascend_mindie_ubuntu_aarch64:20260305_ubuntu24_3.0.0_cann8.5.1_torch2.9.0_py311) which has torch 2.9.0 + torch_npu 2.9.0.post1 pre-installed
problems_encountered.source: pip install torch==2.9.0 timed out after 600s with only 4.3MB cached

problems_encountered.problem: torch compiled_with_cxx11_abi()=True (ABI=1) but third-party built with GLOBAL_ABI_VERSION=0 (ABI=0)
problems_encountered.solution: Set GLOBAL_ABI_VERSION=0 for ms build to match third-party ABI. Build succeeded without link errors.
problems_encountered.source: setup.py use_cxx11_abi() detects ABI from torch (True), but build.sh defaults to GLOBAL_ABI_VERSION=0

problems_encountered.problem: build.sh unconditionally sets NUM_PROC=$(nproc)=256, overriding 20% limit; setup.py calls build.sh without --parallel
problems_encountered.solution: Restarted container with --cpuset-cpus=0-50 so nproc reports 51 inside container, naturally enforcing 20% CPU limit for all build commands
problems_encountered.source: build/build.sh line 38: NUM_PROC=$(nproc) overwrites any exported NUM_PROC

problems_encountered.problem: DT test CMakeLists expects googletest at ${BUILD_MIES_3RDPARTY_INSTALL_DIR}/googletest/{include,lib} (pre-installed layout) but third_party only had source at third_party/src/googletest/
problems_encountered.solution: Built and installed googletest 1.13.0 to third_party/install/googletest/ with cmake install (libgtest.a, libgtest_main.a, libgmock.a, include/gtest/gtest.h)

problems_encountered.problem: DT test CMakeLists needs cpp-stub at ${BUILD_MIES_3RDPARTY_INSTALL_DIR}/cpp-stub but only source existed at third_party/src/cpp-stub/
mindie_ms_controller_ut crashed with Segmentation fault (exit=139, SIGSEGV, core dumped)
problems_encountered.solution: Recorded as partial_success. Root cause likely TestNPURecoveryManager accessing NPU 0 which is in Critical health state. All other 5 UT suites and all ST system tests passed.

problems_encountered.problem: C++ llt tests (mindie_motor/src/test/llt/CMakeLists.txt) are outdated — reference non-existent paths (common/Logger.h, deployer/infer_manager, common/http_client is empty)
problems_encountered.solution: Used the newer DT tests (tests/ms/dt/) via build.sh -b ms-test instead, which use env-var-based paths and are compatible with current source structure
problems_encountered.source: mindie_motor/src/test/llt/CMakeLists.txt lines 51-58 reference moved/removed source files

documentation_gaps.body: build_guide.md does not mention that torch must be pre-installed (needed for ABI detection and LD_LIBRARY_PATH)
DT test CMakeLists expects googletest pre-installed at third_party/install/googletest/ but build.sh -d 3rd only downloads source to third_party/src/googletest/ (no install step for gtest)
C++ llt tests (mindie_motor/src/test/llt/) are outdated and reference non-existent source paths
build.sh unconditionally sets NUM_PROC=$(nproc), making --parallel the only way to limit concurrency; setup.py calls build.sh without --parallel
